title: When the Lab Remembers
claim: The frozen nominal candidate exceeds a predeclared dimensionless fresh-preparation response threshold of 0.85.
scope: Computational benchmark; no experimentally measured materials properties or hardware validation.
mass_balance: Fixed final batch mass/volume. actual=(1-r)*nominal+r*residual, with r=rho*eta**wash_count the retained fraction of the final batch; nominal and residual are nonnegative ternary mass fractions summing to one. Washing reduces residual contribution; no solvent blank or unmodeled fourth component is used.
fresh_action: An independent preparation and assay of the nominal composition is available to all methods; it leaves the shared line residual unchanged and costs four assumed cost units by default.
latent_information: Only the simulator and scorer know true carryover, wash efficacy and clean response. Policies receive commanded compositions, wash counts, fresh flags, assumed costs and noisy observations.
inference: Finite-grid Bayesian model averaging over carryover and wash retention; conditional Bayesian linear regression in six quadratic Bernstein mixture features. Noise standard deviation assumed known at 0.03. Primary model assumes last-actual-composition memory.
active_action_rule: For the moment-matched joint distribution of clean-candidate latent response theta and the next observation Y, utility is Cov(theta,Y)^2 / Var(Y) / action_cost. This is linear-projection variance reduction, not exact expected Bayesian model-average posterior variance reduction or threshold entropy reduction.

decision.coverage_claim: No finite-sample or arbitrary-misspecification reliability guarantee is claimed.

evaluation_seeds: 10000 through 10399 inclusive, disjoint from development seeds 0-19. Same seeded surface across regimes; inference is per regime and no pooled independent-campaign uncertainty is used.
pilot_changes: Original development pilot: seeds 0-9, first six regimes, eight policies, 60 campaigns and 480 policy runs. Completed before report seeds were used. No false confirmations observed in this small pilot; washing and candidate repetition were already competitive.

Increased planned campaigns from 120 to 400 per regime to improve precision for rare false-confirmation rates; did not change response family, peak range, threshold, observation noise or prior based on performance.
Added history_repeat to separate inference from adaptive action selection, and active_no_cost to ablate cost division.
Added expensive wash and cheap/expensive fresh sensitivity, off-grid carryover/wash retention (.32,.35), and severe carryover (.7,.2); all declared before evaluation.
Corrected target-assay classification to nominal composition equality, and added deterministic affordable routine fallback to history_fixed.
Clarified fixed final-volume semantics, known initial residual, approximation used for utility, and hypothetical first-crossing interpretation.
primary_evaluation: Fixed budget cap of 16 assumed cost units. Evaluate the final decision after the policy completes its affordable actions. Equal caps do not imply equal realized spend: wash-only and fresh-only policies may retain a remainder smaller than their next scheduled action; history_fixed falls back to affordable routine candidate repetition. No early termination.
outcomes: false fraction among accepted (undefined if no accepts)
false acceptance conditional on invalid candidate
false rejection per campaign and conditional on valid candidate
uncertainty: Regime-specific Wilson 95% intervals for rates; 5000 percentile campaign-seed bootstrap replicates for means and paired differences. Same bootstrap seed indices for active/control within each regime. No multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory significance claim.
limitations: The study uses synthetic dimensionless objectives; no material-specific data or laboratory validation.
The primary smooth quadratic response family is contained in the inference model; nonlinear and long-memory regimes deliberately violate assumptions.
Known observation noise and initial residual state simplify inference; unknown calibration/noise and arbitrary hidden apparatus effects are not addressed.
Model probabilities are not universal reliability certificates and no finite-sample frequentist coverage guarantee is claimed.
Carryover magnitudes and costs are controlled assumed scenarios, not measured prevalence or experimental time.
Repeated candidate dispensing can flush carryover; adaptive controls may provide no benefit or may underperform.
Fixed-cost actions can leave different budget remainders; budgets are caps, not equal realized expenditure.
One-step covariance utility ignores look-ahead value and exact Bayesian model-discrimination information.
Same seeded surface is reused across regimes; do not treat regime rows as independent for pooled inference.
initial_condition: A known priming mixture h0=[1,0,0] initializes the shared line and every inference particle. Known initialization and known observation sigma=0.03 are favorable assumptions.
target_assay_rule: A target assay is any observation whose commanded nominal recipe equals the frozen candidate, including a conditioning vertex if that vertex equals the candidate.
illustrations: Development seed 7 in strong_carryover, ineffective_wash and nonlinear_response_stress, declared before evaluation. Full discovery and all-policy trajectories exported. No evaluation example is selected for the main mechanism figure.
surface_definition: Abstract dimensionless response: peak - .35*sum_j weight_j*(x_j-center_j)^2; center~Dirichlet(1.5,1.5,1.5), peak~Uniform(.80,1.02), each weight~Uniform(.5,1.1). Nonlinear stress adds .10 sin(8x0+phase0) sin(7x1+phase1)+.12 exp(-||x-bumpcenter||^2/.025)-.03. Phases uniform [0,2pi], bumpcenter~Dirichlet(1.2,1.2,1.2).
primary_comparison: active_confirmation versus history_repeat, controlling the inference model and discovery evidence while changing action selection.
secondary_stopping_outcome: First non-unresolved threshold crossing and its cost are hypothetical descriptive outputs. Runs continue to the fixed budget cap, so these are not results of an executed early-stopping policy.
audit: Independent read-only algebra, latent-boundary, utility and aggregation checks completed before evaluation. Nine deterministic scientific unit tests passed.
